Dear Milk Makeup Team,

We believe that a behind-the-scenes look at the creation of a new product line would resonate well with your core audience of Gen Z and younger Millennials. This post would showcase the process of product development, from concept to launch, helping to build a community around your brand and reach a wider audience.

We propose a collaborative Instagram post series that highlights the behind-the-scenes process of your new product line. This would not only showcase your innovation and authenticity but also help to reach a wider audience.

We look forward to discussing this opportunity further.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
